ourKits.combo: Stampede to drag a target, Smash 'n Grab to pull and stun, Warlord's Challenge to stun and steal power, then Double Pain to cleave and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Chain pull and stuns onto one target while Bloodlust bleed stacks and Warlord's Challenge attack speed shred them.
ourKits.passive: Bloodlust makes basics stack a bleed for damage over time.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage that can hit the target he drags and stuns.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stampede has a delay before the charge and Smash 'n Grab channels before the shockwave, so sidestep both. Fight after he spends them, and buy anti-heal against Double Pain's heal.

ourKits.combo: Containment Fence traps a target, Stasis Bomb stuns from range, Ion Strike blasts to stun the center and slow the edge, and Photon Disruptor slows
ourKits.winCondition: trap a target in the fence and chain stuns so the team collapses
ourKits.passive: jumping mid-air fires Rocket Boots upward and speeds nearby allies; abilities cut its cooldown
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun and fence into a kill
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb, whose stun gets longer the farther it travels; step out of the Ion Strike center during its delay; stay out of the fence ring or flank around it; tenacity shortens her stuns

ourKits.combo: Saturation Charge mines to slow, Frag Order to launch enemies, Orbital Sanction to track them, Rally Point to knock back divers and heal allies.
ourKits.winCondition: Hold an area with Orbital Sanction and mines while Rally Point keeps his team healthy and his rifle on infinite ammo.
ourKits.passive: Ballistic Calibration turns bonus attack speed into ability haste and unlocks ability upgrades at item stat thresholds.
ourKits.playWith: Frontliners who fight inside Rally Point's heal and hold enemies in the Orbital beam.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
ourKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
ourKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

enemyKits.combo: First Intent dash in for a shield, Ashen Vow outer edge to slow and empower Cindara, Swan Song to restrain the target and set her blade Ablaze, then Minueta stabs to execute.
enemyKits.winCondition: Land Swan Song on a key target to restrain them and spend the Ablaze window with longer range and more power, finishing with Minueta.
enemyKits.passive: Last Light: she uses Energy instead of Mana, restores Energy on takedowns, and turns bonus mana into physical power.
enemyKits.playWith: Engage or CC teammates who group enemies for Ashen Vow and help her reach the restrained target.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Ashen Vow has a short channel and its slow is on the outer edge, so step inside or away. She is Unstoppable during Swan Song, so save CC for after it; fight her after First Intent's shield is spent. Armor answers her physical damage.

enemyKits.combo: Thunk to knock back and stun, March! to boost his current Song aura for the team, then channel Crash Bang Boom! to stack slows into a Mesmerize and finish with a knock up and stun.
enemyKits.winCondition: Start fights with Thunk and keep the team moving or healing with Song of My People and March!, then lock a group with his ult.
enemyKits.passive: Mosh Pit: he gains physical power and both armors for each nearby hero, ally or enemy.
enemyKits.playWith: A brawling team that rides his speed or healing aura into fights and follows up on his ult.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Sidestep the small Thunk area, and walk out of Crash Bang Boom! early since he slows himself while channeling and it only Mesmerizes at max stacks. Spread out so Mosh Pit gives him fewer stacks.

enemyKits.combo: Peekaboo! to mark, reveal and slow → Knock, Knock! snipe on the marked target → Back It Up! to drag a fleeing hero back
enemyKits.winCondition: land Knock, Knock! on Peekaboo!-marked targets for max-health damage and reset Surprise, Surprise! on takedowns
enemyKits.passive: his vision item becomes a camouflaged Sonar Drone that reveals enemies through walls
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds targets still for his snipe, and teammates who follow up when Back It Up! returns a hero
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Peekaboo! since Knock, Knock! is much stronger on marked targets; after Back It Up! teleports you back, expect a follow-up, and pressure him after Surprise, Surprise! is spent

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slows, the empowered basic attaches a Cosmic Tether that roots, Cosmic Rift lands on the rooted target, then Black Hole drags the group together
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole and Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for area burst
enemyKits.passive: hitting a hero with an ability empowers his next basic attack to tether the target, dealing damage then rooting them
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Void Breach and Cosmic Rift; Torn Space is his only escape, so dive him after it is used; walk out of Black Hole early since it drags slowly; magic armor blunts his burst

enemyKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade to block then swing for a stun → Spear of Nyr (bonus damage on low targets) → Coliseum leap to finish
enemyKits.winCondition: leap onto a target with Coliseum for doubled Gladiator power and secure kills to stack permanent power
enemyKits.passive: Gladiator stacks grant physical power and heal him as they fall off after combat
enemyKits.playWith: a team that follows his Coliseum leap onto the target
enemyKits.playAgainst: Barricade only blocks from the front, so hit him from the side or behind and dodge its swing stun; disengage during Coliseum's doubled-power window, and buy armor and anti-heal

bullets: Every basic attack set off Resolution, Viper and Deathstalker, and Viper added 10% damage to eroded heroes, so steady shooting between Knock, Knock! shots kept paying off.
Weald fired true-damage missiles through walls at heroes below 30%, pairing with Vanquisher on low targets; Taproot healed on basic attacks and Forage added minion gold.
Knock, Knock! finishing blows paid Sniper's Bounty's 40g per hero, and Liberator cleansed debuffs with a shield so he could keep shooting.
Knell's Rust from her stabs and swings shredded armor and gave her 75% of it, Fracture added damage at max Rust, and Patina's shield cushioned the opening poke.
Every ability empowered her next swing through Solaris, which healed her for 50% of its damage, while Nightfall healed 6% of ability damage to heroes.
First Intent's shield grew on each hero hit, and Brutallax cleansed debuffs and kept tenacity running as long as her basic attacks kept landing.
Evade and Coliseum leaps empowered his next attack through Berserker's Axe with a 55% slow, so targets stayed in reach for Spear of Nyr's low-health finish.
Lotus rolled a random bonus on each of 11 takedowns, Masterpiece stacked damage and speed per kill, and Immaculate cut damage 10% above 85% health on engage.
Tainted Blade cut enemy healing, then ability hits on those blighted targets made them take 5% more, Earthshaker stacked twice as fast, and Judgement healed per hero hit.
